question: A newborn is brought to the pediatric clinic by his mother because she has noticed a swelling in the belly while dressing her baby. On physical examination, the newborn is found to have a non-tender upper abdominal mass. The clinician also noticed absent irises and undescended testes in this baby. A magnetic resonance image (MRI) scan of the abdomen shows a mass of intra-renal origin. Which 1 of the following genetic disorders is most probably the cause of this neonate’s symptoms and signs?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Newborn presents with abdominal swelling" -> "Physical exam reveals non-tender upper abdominal mass" -> "MRI shows mass of intra-renal origin" -> "Absent irises and undescended testes noted" -> "Signs suggest possible genetic disorder" -> "WT-1 gene associated with Wilms tumor and genitourinary anomalies" -> "WT-1 missense mutation likely cause" -> 85%

CHAIN: "Newborn presents with abdominal swelling" -> "Physical exam reveals non-tender upper abdominal mass" -> "MRI shows mass of intra-renal origin" -> "Absent irises and undescended testes noted" -> "Possible association with genetic syndromes" -> "Deletion 11-p-13 linked to Wilms tumor and aniridia" -> "Deletion 11-p-13 could explain symptoms" -> 80%

CHAIN: "Newborn presents with abdominal swelling" -> "Physical exam reveals non-tender upper abdominal mass" -> "MRI shows mass of intra-renal origin" -> "Absent irises and undescended testes noted" -> "Consider genetic disorders related to kidney tumors" -> "Deletion 11-p-15 not typically associated with these findings" -> "Less likely cause" -> 60%

CHAIN: "Newborn presents with abdominal swelling" -> "Physical exam reveals non-tender upper abdominal mass" -> "MRI shows mass of intra-renal origin" -> "Absent irises and undescended testes noted" -> "Duplication of 11-p-15 not commonly linked to these symptoms" -> "Unlikely cause" -> 50%

CHAIN: "Newborn presents with abdominal swelling" -> "Physical exam reveals non-tender upper abdominal mass" -> "MRI shows mass of intra-renal origin" -> "Absent irises and undescended testes noted" -> "Amplification of MYCN associated with neuroblastoma, not Wilms tumor" -> "Unlikely cause" -> 40%
analysis: The symptoms presented in the newborn, including the abdominal mass, absent irises (aniridia), and undescended testes, are suggestive of a genetic disorder associated with Wilms tumor and other anomalies. The WT1 gene is known to be involved in syndromes such as WAGR (Wilms tumor, Aniridia, Genitourinary abnormalities, and Range of developmental delays) and Denys-Drash syndrome, both of which can present with these findings. A missense mutation in the WT1 gene would be consistent with these symptoms. Therefore, the most probable cause of this neonate's symptoms is a WT-1 missense mutation.
